long_stride.label: Long Stride
long_stride.note: Stretched leg assembly. Faster than the tonnage suggests, and lightly built for it.

narrow_profile.label: Narrow Profile
narrow_profile.note: Slab-sided hull presents very little to shoot at from the front.

wide_stance.label: Wide Stance
wide_stance.note: Widened hips. Steadier gun platform on the move, and hard to knock over.

reinforced_legs.label: Reinforced Legs
reinforced_legs.note: Overbuilt actuators. Losing one hurts far less than it should.

oversized_sinks.label: Oversized Sinks
oversized_sinks.note: Compact-pattern heat exchangers the foundry never worked out how to shrink.

sensor_mast.label: Sensor Mast
sensor_mast.note: Dedicated mast above the cockpit line. Sees a long way before it is seen.

hardened_mantlet.label: Hardened Mantlet
hardened_mantlet.note: Slab of Sarn plate bolted across the front. Shrugs off what lesser hulls absorb.

command_console.label: Command Console
command_console.note: Second seat running the lance net. Everyone shoots a little better with it on the field.

unstable_capacitors.label: Unstable Capacitors
unstable_capacitors.note: Foundry-built power train that has never once passed inspection first time.
